About Adam

Care built on technique and attention.

Adam has built his practice one client and one referral at a time across Central and West London. His work covers real ground: firm sports and deep tissue technique for people who are genuinely sore and tight, chair-based acupressure for those short on time, and Thai foot and relaxing massage for people who just need to switch off.

He trained through Gateway Workshops, a recognised training school for massage and complementary therapy, and holds diplomas in Chair/Seated Acupressure On Site Massage and Traditional Thai Foot Massage. He’s fully insured through Towergate to practise.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Where do sessions take place?

Sessions take place in Adam’s private treatment room, on a professional table. Mobile visits may be available on request — feel free to reach out and ask. Please note prices may vary for mobile visits.

How do I pay?

Cash is the preferred payment method, taken just before your session — so there’s no deposit to arrange in advance. Card or bank transfer can be arranged instead if needed, just let Adam know when you book.

What is your cancellation policy?

Please give at least 24 hours’ notice where possible to reschedule or cancel, so the time can be offered to someone else.

How should I prepare for my session?

Everything is provided in the treatment room, so there’s nothing to bring. On the day, make sure you’re well hydrated and avoid eating for at least 2 hours beforehand. Please let Adam know of any injuries before you start.

Is Adam qualified and insured?

Yes. Adam holds Practitioner’s Diplomas from Gateway Workshops in Chair/Seated Acupressure and Traditional Thai Foot Massage, and is professionally insured through Towergate.
